name: Mocking
overview: Scripture reveals mocking as a serious offense characterized by scorn and derision toward God and others, as seen when Sarah observed Ishmael mocking (Genesis 21:9). The ungodly are warned against joining the scornful, who reject wisdom and understanding (Psalms 1:1; Proverbs 14:6). Proverbs further illustrates God's response, declaring He will mock and laugh at the calamity of the fearful (Proverbs 1:26). Job’s experience highlights the pain of being mocked by younger men, emphasizing the depth of this reproach (Job 30:1).
